steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Cheers—!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Congrats, kid! That was a beautiful match! You're much stronger than V now!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yes, she is, but who made you the judge!?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Huuhh?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Why are you two fighting again...? Hey now, stop it. You're disturbing the other customers.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahaha... They're arm wrestling already...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That was a good one indeed, kid. This one is for you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... thank you!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Not only did you manage to find Szewczyk's weakness, you even finished him in one blow. You did really well.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The fight lasted for almost twenty minutes. Maria had been at a disadvantage during most of the fight, but she turned the tables on him with just one crucial strike—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: —Very well done.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-It wasn't anything special... I wouldn't have been able to do it if he wasn't wearing a flawed set of armor...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'd never heard of the model Jack 2 before... If the cooling system could paralyze the armor even for a short time, then it's definitely still a prototype.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: —That said, Szewczyk's an experienced competition knight, and endorsing untested products actually isn't that uncommon at all. He also managed to hide the armor's weaknesses well.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Don't be so humble. It's barbaric, but the Major has always been about results and results only.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't get too ahead of yourself!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You need to know how to control your emotions—Don't just act normal, you need to proactively reflect on yourself and normalize your emotions...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...The less you think complacency's an issue, the more dangerous it is. It's very difficult to realize yourself just what victory does to your emotions...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And that carelessness... will... be the end of you!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: G-Got it!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Auntie? Are you drunk?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No! And don't call me 'Auntie!'

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: —I won!!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Sod it, Kowal. How did you get this buff in just half a year?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I've been fixing pipes. You've got a problem with that?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Kowal, Vogelweide, is Zofia...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... Call me 'Auntie'... one more time... I'll... mess ya upp...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Yeah... Looks like she's really drunk. Don't see that often.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I... I'm not... drunk!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Fine, whatever you say. Maria, take your aunt to the couch in the back. Let her sleep it off there.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh... O-Okay... Auntie, lift your leg up...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Who's yer 'Auntie?!'

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Zofia can usually really hold her liquor... Well, not that she can drink as much as me.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Just because you had drinks with a few folks from Yan once, you're all full of yourself? Have you no shame, trying to beat a young lady at downing booze?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She's under a lot of pressure... It's her first time watching a match as a coach, and she had to listen to Greatmouth Mob jabber on and on.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That brings back memories... *Sigh*, I've been like this ever since Maria won. I guess I'm old now.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What are you talking about? We're all about the same age!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I guess that means I'm actually old, then.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: ...Yeah, how long ago was it when Zofia first stepped into the arena? Twelve years ago? Fifteen?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: How old you are is none of my business, and I don't remember exactly when, but Zofia's not that old...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It was nine years ago, wasn't it? The Blood Knight, The Radiant Knight, The Black Knight... It was three seasons ago.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The Black Knight... That Caprinae, huh? Feels like a lifetime ago.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Well, she won the three Majors before that too. The media likes to treat her like some sort of emblem of that generation or something.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh, the three-time consecutive winner?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Yeah, normally, they don't pick words that common when they come up with titles, lest they get repeated and complicate things.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: But that Leithanian lass. She actually deserves the title 'Black.' She's a monster, no mistake.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I heard she's working for some large company outside the country, tsk, tsk.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Someone like her's no knight... Not in my book.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I see...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Maria, has Zofia ever told you anything about her career in the Major?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No. There are the videos and stats from each season, but she hasn't told me anything herself...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I think Auntie Zofia made it to the top 16 that year, and during the round of 16...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's right. She was heavily wounded.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Her opponent was the 'Fissure.' That reminds me, did he enter the Major this year?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Why are we talking about the past? We're here to celebrate Maria's win!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: That wasn't a very fun story anyway. Let's move on to something else!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Actually... I'm kinda curious about that...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I managed to win, but it doesn't seem like Zofia's very happy about it... She didn't even say anything and went straight to drinking...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm sure she thought really hard about all this for me... I don't want to let her down... so I want to know more about her past and how she feels about everything.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Well... You're just like your sister when it comes to that.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's right. You're always quick to notice if something's amiss, and you always try to do something about it.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That last attack of the match. Did Zofia teach you that?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: N-No, actually—

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You copied Margaret's move?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh? Oh, umm... Yeah... was it obvious?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hahaha, of course. You two are so alike! And I'll never forget that day.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The miracle of the Radiant Knight, the youngest ever champion. She accomplished all that without help from anyone else.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: And she doesn't show it, but Zofia actually really looks up to Margaret.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She was just a lady-in-waiting to your family, but she really tried her hardest. She even had us old farts help her train...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She entered the preliminaries, won, and made it into the Major... From the beginning all the way to the end, she didn't accept any sponsorship offers, nor did she ever ask anyone for help.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Heh... I even introduced her to a few small businesses I knew back in the day, but she turned down every one of them.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...Those companies are all trash. She made the right call to turn them down.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Shut up. That's exactly why 'Fissure' defeated Zofia.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What happened...?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maria, a competition knight needs a lot of resources... That's something you'll come to know... The weapons and equipment you bring to battle could be the difference between life and death.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Szewczyk probably only lost to you because the armor they made him wear had a design flaw.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Suppose he wore a set of armor that had no flaws at all, maybe even with far superior capabilities. What happens then? Do you think you could've won?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Probably not...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That's the kind of opponent Zofia faced. Flawless armor, weapons, and support. The difference between them was immense.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia paid for her own equipment. She perfected her technique all alone, and she made all the connections herself. It was just her, and she fought so hard.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: We never did anything for her except watch her get hurt and throw in the towel.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Was there anything we could've done?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Marcin...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: At the very least, you could help Zofia train the kid.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hahaha, I doubt Maria would want to be coached by ol' one-armed Marcin, the same man who had a hand in Zofia's injury, indirectly.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No, I would love to! I've always admired all of you! I mean it!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hm? It's not often we get other customers. How unusual...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You'll probably go out of business at this rate.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Excuse me... Are you Maria Nearl, the knightess?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uh... That's right.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Pleased to meet you, Ms. Maria. Do you have time to talk right now?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Sure, is there something I can do for you?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I'm here to represent the Słoma Corporation... Here is my business card.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Please accept my apologies. My company's representative has sent several invitations to your residence, but we have yet to receive a reply. I'm sorry for visiting you here uninvited.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... uh... I think... there's a bit of problem with our mailbox... Haha...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So, did you need something from me?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: You see, my company is one of the sponsors of the Eszeweria Knightclub. Its leader was very impressed by your performance against Mr. Szewczyk.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: As soon as he found out you are not currently affiliated, he wanted to know if you would be interested in a contract with the knightclub, and contacted our business department to facilitate discussion...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...They want to sign me?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes... and actually, our CEO is very interested in having you on board...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: (Kowal, isn't Słoma the food company that has straws in their logo?)

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: (You moron. Why don't you take a look at the logo they stamped on those saltines you're eating?)

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: (Eszeweria is one of the top 100 knightclubs... Though they're a bunch of businesspeople more interested in making money from sponsorships and ads than entering competitions...)

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Not only that, but MARTHE Kazimierz's PR Department has also pledged to cosponsor all of the knightclub's future developments with Słoma, should you agree to sign with the club.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: MA-MARTHE!? You mean that MARTHE?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, that's correct. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Mm... How did I... How long have I been out?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh, Zofia, you're up.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Not that long. You slept for about ten minutes only...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I can't be napping. We still have to plan out where we're getting the rest of our points this month—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Zofia? I-Is that you?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh. Yeah, I remember you. You're that young manager at...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: No, not anymore... Now I'm just a... nobody running errands for Słoma...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I see, so 'Whislash' is Ms. Maria's coach. All the better.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: There are many young and enterprising knights like you two on the Eszeweria Knightclub's roster. The business department has many ways to further your reputation and worth without merely resorting to tournament matches...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But it sounds like...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...You'll be something like a star or an idol. Your face will be all over the intercity net, and no one will care about your scores in the competitions anymore. They'll just be throwing money at whatever they see your face on.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That's kinda hard to believe...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's how the industry works. They spend nearly all of their budget on finding spokesmen. Then, they film some phony ads to try to make a buck from the ordinary folks.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's simple, and it's a lot more effective than you think. Makes you wonder where the problem actually lies.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...That is more or less the case, if put in less flattering terms. However, on behalf of the General Chamber of Commerce, the Słoma company can promise that you will still be conferred both the knighthood and a title.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...What do you want to do?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: This is way too sudden, I...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Honestly... I think it's okay to accept their offer.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You won't need to put yourself in harm's way, and the family will keep its nobility. It's a good deal. You might even have a bigger garden than me come this time next year.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But yours is full of nothing but weeds. I'm not sure what I'd do with a garden even bigger than that...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: N-Never mind.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: If you agree right now, we have an agreement here, ready to go. Rest assured, you will find the terms very favorable.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'm sorry... but I don't want my family crest to become some commercial trinket. At the very least, I don't want to have to rely on anyone...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...I beg your pardon?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yeah, I know, Zofia.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I don't like how Uncle Młynar does things, but I don't want to bring shame to Margaret and Grandpa's struggle.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: So... I'm sorry, but I don't think that is the right path for me to take...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Well... your response is certainly... unexpected...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: H-However, the General Chamber of Commerce has prepared for you an assortment of proposals—Please have a look.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The Chamber? Isn't this usually under the Association's purview?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Err... I-I'm sure you understand. This is why our CEO insists you join us...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yeah, thanks... but... I'm sorry, I have to refuse.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Y-Yes, I understand. Right... You refuse... uhh...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Well... Ms. Zofia, Ms. Maria... This isn't part of the business proposal, but please at least hear me out...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uh... your teeth are chattering... A-Are you crying? All I did was decline your offer... It's no big deal!

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Uh, n-no... I'm simply hoping that... in the event that anyone else comes to you—Ms. Maria, in particular—with any business propositions, please—

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: —Please seriously consider accepting! I'm begging you. This is very important to us...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: N-Now... please excuse me... before I embarrass myself any more...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Helping other companies out...? That's a new one.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yeah... That's really strange.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria, when is your next match?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: In three days.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Who are you up against? Did the Association contact you?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uh... I guess not?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's go home, Maria. Judging from your performance this time, you still have lots of room for improvement.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Now? We haven't even started celebrating!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Kowal, let them go.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia, be careful. Keep an eye peeled.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Yeah, I got it. Let's go, Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Okay, wait up—!
...Ingra? 'Brassrust' Ingra? The National Council let him go again?
Well, what did you expect? That huge megacorporation has his back... The Victorians he crippled must be peeved.
But well... This is perfect.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ladies and Gentlemen!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: No promises, no rules, and no limits!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Here, we have two knights, their armor, a battlefield, and nothing else! Rules, conditions, arrangements, protective measures, nothing!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: As the most important preliminary event of the Kazimierz Major, these tryouts have been going on for three months already, and there are still contestants throwing their hats in the ring!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Even so, I dare say, what we're about to witness today is unlike anything we've seen before!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The contestants standing before us now both come from long lines of knights!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Yes, yes, I can hear you hiss. Worry not! This will be among the most entertaining matches you've seen, and I put my career and reputation on the line to say that!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You are bound to start cheering the moment you hear their names! You have my word!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: First, on this side, we have the youngest son of the Ingra family, Olmer Ingra!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's right. He's the one who been taken to court countless times for crippling anyone who dares cross him, and thanks to the coffers of his countless sponsors has been ruled innocent over and over by the National Council! 'Brassrust' Ingra!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Butcher of the Field from the Bloodboil Knightclub! The ruthless knight who has never allowed even a single opponent to step out of the ring in one piece!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He will beat his armor, his rage, and his mercilessness into the heart of each and every one of his opponents! And most likely their skulls, too!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And on the other side! The other side—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Oh, ooh! One of the oldest knight families, Nearl! Let us say their name out loud! Nearl!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The hero of Kazimierz who outsmarted the Leithanians all by himself, the Tenebrous Knight who assassinated the king's traitorous retinue, and, last but not least, the Radiant Knight, the embodiment of shame who was exiled for getting infected!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: All of them came from this family!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's that? Not up for a history lesson? Fine! Well then, who managed to defeat the Roar K.C.'s vanguard, Szewczyk, before she even got her own title?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Who's the Roar Arena most popular knight of the month?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Will all this change because of this one match? Will 'Brassrust' bash in this pretty little face of hers?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let us welcome—Maria Nearl—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What will be the outcome of this battle? Who will reign victorious? Pick up the terminals next to your seats and start voting!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: You know the rules! Your monetary support won't influence the match's outcome, but it will directly influence whether your wallet's empty or brimming with cash!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Maria!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's forfeit this match... okay? Just listen to me this once. Just this match...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Auntie?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I've already entered the battlefield... As a knight, I mustn't back down.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Go get him, Maria.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Show everyone here what you're made of.
